messages:
Aisha K.: Hey all, first day but hitting a snag — Okta login returns 'SAML assertion audience mismatch' when I try to sign into Google. No 1Password invite either. Anyone know who manages the SAML config? Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/diags/saml-aisha.png
Theo M.: welcome Aisha! tagging IT — usually that error means your Google alias didn't sync with Okta org. What's your email?
Aisha K.: aisha.k@redwood.ai
IT-Bot: Created ticket IT-4899 for aisha.k@redwood.ai. Assigned: Theo M. Priority: P2.
Theo M.: I can see your Okta entry but it's got an alternate email (a.k@redwood.ai) instead of the canonical one. Pushing an attribute sync to identity provider now.
People Ops Bot: Note: New-hire device stipend and laptop preference form is pending for Aisha K. Link: https://redwood-internal/hr/onboard/2381234567
Aisha K.: Thanks. Also curious about MFA options — I have a YubiKey I prefer, but the Okta flow only shows phone + passkey. Is YubiKey allowed?
Jared L.: Security here. YubiKeys are allowed. We default to phone + passkey for UX but hardware keys can be enabled. File a request in #people-ops or reply here and we can flip the policy for your account.
Theo M.: Sync finished. Okta now shows primaryEmail = aisha.k@redwood.ai, groups include eng-new-joins. Try signing into Google again.
Aisha K.: Trying now — Google login worked! I can see my inbox but 1Password still shows "No access".
IT-Bot: 1Password seat queued. Provisioning step started.
Aisha K.: Got 1Password invite. Set up account and added SSH key. Thanks all. One more: when I click 'Enroll device' it asks to install company profile. Is that MDM? I'm on a personal laptop.
Jared L.: The prompt is for device-attestation via passkeys and does not enroll in MDM by default. Only corporate devices get Jamf. If you pick "Company laptop" option we can provision a managed laptop.
Aisha K.: Great. One last tiny thing: my Google Drive doesn't show the 'eng-resources' folder.
Theo M.: Added you to Drive group eng-resources. It can take a minute to propagate.
IT-Bot: Drive ACL update completed for aisha.k@redwood.ai.
Aisha K.: Now I see the folder. All set — appreciate the quick help folks :sparkles:
